mintAuthority.summary: stcUSD is an ERC-4626 UUPS wrapper over Cap cUSD. Wrapper minting is deposit/share accounting with no privileged mint path; upgrade authority routes through Cap's AccessControl → 24-hour TimelockController (0 proposers/executors = fully renounced). Wrapper is effectively immutable; durable cUSD mint authority is inherited from reviewed Cap vault controls.
